newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at Mar Brent +44 and +33 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at Mar Brent +44 and +33 cents.

text.p: Dated Brent traded twice on Friday both above and below the last reported deal but traders valued the benchmark grade slightly weaker.
A Feb 11-13 cargo which fetched Mar Brent +42 cents on Thursday was sold for Mar Brent +44 cents on Friday.
But a second cargo loading a day later traded at Mar Brent +33 cents, traders said.
"I think the market is probably somewhere in between," said a trader.
Five Brent cargoes were still passing through the foward paper chains.
